generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily executed and completed as a prime contractor of Operation and maintenance works of ash handling system in any thermal power plants. OR The intending bidder should have satisfactorily executed and completed as a prime contractor at least one work pertaining to the Erection/Mechanical maintenance works in ash handling system of any thermal power plants. The bidder should have satisfactorily executed the above work of single work order of value not less than Rs.20.67 Lakhs(excluding GST) in the preceding FIVE(05) years. The bidder shall upload the scanned copy of work order and corresponding work done certificate from KPCL/NTPC/any SEB/ Govt. Organisation/reputed private organization issued by competent authority. (Work done value for previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year, in which tenders are invited).

The intending bidder in his name should have average annual financial turnover of not less than Rs.41.34 lakhs (Excluding GST) achieved in any TWO of the preceding five financial years. The intending bidder should upload the scanned copy of original latest audited turn over certificate including profit and loss balance sheets account for preceding five completed financial years countersigned by charted accountant as documentary evidence. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to present price level of the financial year in which tenders is invited).

technicalCriterionList.description: TThe intending bidder shall not have been subject to forfeiture of EMD/foreclosure/termination of their contract in KPCL/government or any other utility and have not been blacklisted for participation in tender issued by KPCL or government or any other utility in India during the past 10 years.

Declaration by the bidder that he has studied the site conditions, labour conditions and read bid documents and related matters carefully and diligently and that he has submitted the bid having studied understood and accepted the full implications of the agreement.
The bidder shall sign and upload scanned copy of the Form of Bid (ANNEXURE-I) as per format enclosed.

The Bidder shall quote rates exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other applicable taxes, levies, duties and cess etc., as per the prevailing regulations of GOI and GOK. Declaration in this regard has to be furnished as per Annexure-VI.

The bidder should be free from any of the statutory body appraisal/obligation/charges undergoing & shall produce relevant proof declaration with an undertaking to get absolved.In this regard declaration to be furnished as per Annexure-VII.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Providing, erection, rotation, commissioning and removal of eroded 350NB Ash slurry pipe line for U-1 & 2 Ash handling system.

itemList.description: Dismantling, disposing, providing, transporting, rolling, lowering, lifting, laying, jointing, commissioning and testing of new 350NB MS ERW PIPE (Electric Resistance Welded) 9.5mm thick with both sides plain end (Fe-410 grade) conforming to IS 3589-2001, Make: TATA/SAIL/JINDAL with latest amendments for ash slurry disposal pipe line.
Providing, dismantling, disposing, erection, commisioning & testing of 350NB CAST BASALT (45Deg) bend for ash slurry disposal pipe line.
Dismantling, rotation, affixing & testing of the existing 350NB MS ERW ash slurry disposal pipe line.

Applying priming coat on 350NB MS ERW Ash slurry disposal pipe line: With ready mixed red oxide zinc chromate primer of approved brand and manufacture including preparing the surface after thorougly cleaning oil, grease, dirt and foreign matter, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Painting of 350NB MS ERW ash slurry disposal pipe line with synthetic enamel paint of approved brand and manufacture to give an even shade :Two coats on new work after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.
